.— J. M. Sengupta, mayor of Calcutta, was sentenced today to 10 days’ imprisonment after conviction on a charge of seditious utterances growing out of his support of Mahatma Gandhi and his campaign of civil disobedience. Sengupta was brought here from Calcutta for trial. He sat mute throughout the proceedings.
